notes.title: Eros Fantasy 2.0 update
notes.notes:
🚀 Eros Fantasy 2.0: Our Biggest Update Yet! 🚀

The Eros Fantasy 2.0 update is finally live, bringing New Dates, Affection Mode, New Challenges, and much more! 🌟

🖼️ Content Highlights:  

26 Dates & H-Scenes  
60 Underwear/Nude Portraits  
2 Cinematic H-Scenes


---

❤️ New Affection System  

Bio Info for All Girls: Explore detailed bios for your favorite characters.  
Gifts & Affection Levels: Send gifts to boost affection, uncover secret likes/dislikes, and unlock:  

Dates  
Underwear & Nude Portraits  
H-Scenes  
Cinematic H-Scenes  



---
✨ New Dates & Rewritten Stories  
Rewritten Dates: Updated to match the new system for these characters:  

Xenia, Liliana, Eleonora, Rachel, Oleen, Oana, Carolina, Xiu-Ying, Mei-Feng, Olivia, Emy, and Chun-Ling.  


Brand-New Dates: Meet these girls in exciting new stories!  

Alexandra, Ivy, Audrey, Lisa, Shannon, Chelsea, Roselyn, Isabella, Lixue-Lang, Ivonne, Gabriela, Daphne, Rebecca, and Valeria.  


(More characters and dates coming soon!)  

---{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290078/fb701f2f3c75ccf8d6829f4c37285c6a2f6d0f5d.png
🎥 Cinematic H-Scenes  

A new type of animated H-Scene featuring variations, effects, and narrative depth.  
Now available:  

Xenia: Unlock at Affection Level 12  
Eleonora: Unlock at Affection Level 15  

Other Changes: Static H-Scenes replace animated ones in dates for now—Cinematic H-Scenes will arrive soon!  


---
👙 Underwear & Nude Portraits  

All girls now have underwear and nude portrait versions—some very spicy! 🔥  
Use these portraits on your Home Screen for a personalized experience.  


---
🏆 New Challenges  

Shard's Challenge 🐉: Fight Dragonards for Orbs & Wildshards (Common, Rare, and Epic).  
Affection Challenge 🌟: Battle Celestials to earn Affection Gifts.  
Silver Challenge ⚔️: Includes new levels 11 and 12!  


---
🎁 Daily Rewards & Events  

Weekly rewards now include Affection items.  
Special Event Calendar: Log in until December 6th to earn Rare and Epic Affection Items!  


---
🎲 New Affection Gachas  

Affection Gacha: 100 Gems 💎  
Affection Premium Gacha: 100 NutakuGold 💰 (Better drop rates + Epic Gift guaranteed on x10 pulls).  


---
We hope you enjoy Eros Fantasy 2.0 and all the exciting new content featuring your favorite girls! Don’t forget to try out the new Challenges! 🌸
